top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards one clear, mature idea, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, realised by Katori and Ye and reproduced at the 10^-18 level by several national laboratories, with the cleanest two-name allocation available and measurable physics (relativistic redshift over millimetres, bounds on drifting constants, dark-matter searches). I accept it is a new regime of measurement more than a new fact about nature. P002 is a genuine discovery, but the trio omits Bernevig and Hughes, whose HgTe prediction Molenkamp tested, and the Z2 class sits close to the 2016 prize, so the citation is harder to defend. A prize this year is better than none.
recusal_note: No conflict with Katori, Ye or their groups, and none with Kane, Mele or Molenkamp. As WACQT director with close ties to Chalmers superconducting-circuit groups I would step back from circuit-QED or squeezing proposals, but neither is on this slate.
